title: Meh
text: Meh. Not very good. This is way too much money for this. It would be appropriately priced at $10.00. This is something you would expect to get at Goodwill for just a dollar or two. Not good quality at all.

Easy to mount to wall surfaces with proper hardware (Mounting hardware not included)
